subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A mountain school had weak internet for years.”?
options: When heavy rain came, online classes often stopped.
But on Friday, heavy rain began before lunch.
A young mother often stopped near the bench while her baby slept.
After a heavy rain, the small stream near school was full of water.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「When heavy rain came, online classes often stopped.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「But on Friday, heavy rain began before lunch.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A young mother often stopped near the bench while her baby slept.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After a heavy rain, the small stream near school was full of water.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「When heavy rain came, online classes often stopped.」，答案為「When heavy rain came, online classes often stopped.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When heavy rain came, online classes often stopped.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
